about_short_description.short_description: Komodo Health is an IT firm that specializes in data engineering, life sciences, artificial intelligence, and machine intelligence services.

product.name: Healthcare Map®
product.description: A de-identified, longitudinal healthcare data foundation covering patient journeys, healthcare providers, organizations, care settings, and payers for real-world analytics.

product.name: Marmot™
product.description: A healthcare-focused AI platform that generates reproducible, traceable, and governed insights from healthcare data for life sciences and healthcare workflows.

product.name: MapLab®
product.description: An AI-enabled enterprise analytics platform that supports no-code, low-code, and high-code workflows for healthcare data analysis and business applications.

product.name: MapEnhance®
product.description: A specialty-data offering that adds pre-integrated sources such as laboratory, electronic health record, genomics, and social determinants of health data to Komodo’s healthcare foundation.

product.name: Mavens Salesforce Software and Services
product.description: Enterprise software and professional services delivered on Salesforce for medical affairs, commercialization, patient engagement, and related healthcare workflows.
